items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Professor Humperty was teaching I told you he played a, he was a tuba player, he played on, and then he played bass, violin, and the band up there on trombone.

ctx.x: Did you know a fellow named Henry Lambert way back?

Yeah, Henry Lambert. He lives out in Jefferson. That's the man played with us when we started our band up there and Professor Humperty was teaching I told you he played a, he was a tuba player, he played on, and then he played bass, violin, and the band up there on trombone. Well that was the old man Lambert, but they got a Lambert up there now, still living in Jefferson Pires, his son. But the old man played with us. He used to play the tuba.
